selection.edition: international CATS Applicant Tracking System API v3 plus Composio CATS (The Cat API) tools
selection.ownership: CATS Software, Inc., a Top Echelon Software subsidiary (Minneapolis, US ATS at catsone.com; not OpenCATS)

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official CATS API v3 docs (host https://api.catsone.com/v3, Authorization Token, GET /site, candidate and job list/get, page/per_page pagination, 429 Retry-After), CATS knowledge-base API article, company identity (US ATS acquired by Top Echelon in 2020), and dated incident search. This is CATS applicant tracking at catsone.com, not OpenCATS and not unrelated CAT-named products. No qualifying current unresolved CATS ATS compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international CATS Applicant Tracking System API v3
research.searchCoverage: Official CATS API v3 documents HTTPS host https://api.catsone.com/v3, Authorization: Token <API key>, GET /site, GET /candidates, GET /candidates/{id}, GET /jobs, GET /jobs/{id}, page/per_page (default 25, max 100), and 429 with Retry-After. Product is the US recruiting ATS at catsone.com, acquired by Top Echelon in 2020. OpenCATS is a different open-source product. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved CATS ATS compromise.

incidents.finding: Bounded search distinguished CATS ATS (catsone.com) from OpenCATS CVEs and unrelated CAT-named incidents. No current unresolved CATS ATS customer-data compromise was identified.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified. catsone.nl is a regional host out of this edition.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /v3/site with empty input, matching the pinned validator. Search endpoints are omitted.
Native category is ats-recruitment: CATS is an applicant tracking system. Source Productivity is not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.
CATS wraps actions in defineAction rather than direct defineProviderAction; catalog admission uses a reviewed-action-ids row for get_site, list_candidates, get_candidate, list_jobs, and get_job.
Returns raw CATS HAL JSON under data. Optional page and per_page use official query names; per_page is bounded to 1–100. Source perPage is mapped to per_page.
GET reads omit the recommended Content-Type: application/json header because native GET requests have no body.
candidate_id is a required positive integer path segment on GET /v3/candidates/{candidate_id}.
Returns raw CATS HAL JSON under data with the same bounded page/per_page query names as candidates.list.
job_id is a required positive integer path segment on GET /v3/jobs/{job_id}.

breeds.get.description: Get detailed information about a specific cat breed by its The Cat API breed ID.

breed_id.description: Unique breed identifier (e.g. pers, beng, siam).

breeds.get.title: Get breed

breeds.list.description: Retrieve a paginated list of cat breeds from The Cat API (Composio CATS_GET_PORTALS).

limit.description: Number of breeds to return per page (1-100).

breeds.list.title: List breeds

breeds.search.description: Search cat breeds by name using The Cat API /breeds/search.

attach_image.description: Whether to attach the reference image (0 no, 1 yes).

q.description: Search term for breed name (part or all of the name).

breeds.search.title: Search breeds

candidates.get.description: Get one CATS candidate by ID.
candidates.get.title: Get candidate

candidates.list.description: List CATS candidates with optional page and per_page filters.
candidates.list.title: List candidates

categories.list.description: Retrieve all active image categories from The Cat API (hats, sunglasses, boxes, sinks, and more).
categories.list.title: List categories

favourites.create.description: Save a cat image as a favourite on The Cat API account, optionally segmented by sub_id.

image_id.description: The ID of the image to save as a favourite.

sub_id.description: Optional user identifier to segment favourites by user or source.

favourites.create.title: Create favourite

favourites.delete.description: Delete a favourite from The Cat API account by its ID.

favourite_id.description: The ID of the favourite to delete.

favourites.delete.title: Delete favourite

favourites.get.description: Retrieve a specific favourite by its unique ID from The Cat API.

favourite_id.description: Unique identifier of the favourite to retrieve.

favourites.get.title: Get favourite

favourites.list.description: List favourites belonging to The Cat API account, optionally filtered by sub_id.

limit.description: Number of favourites to return per page (1-100).

sub_id.description: Filter favourites by sub_id used when creating them.

favourites.list.title: List favourites

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

image_id.description: The unique identifier of the uploaded image to analyze.

images.analysis.get.title: Get image analysis

images.breeds.get.description: Retrieve breed information associated with a specific cat image.

image_id.description: Unique identifier of the image to retrieve breed information for.

images.breeds.get.title: Get image breeds

images.delete.description: Delete an uploaded image from The Cat API account by its ID.

image_id.description: Unique identifier of the uploaded image to delete.

images.delete.title: Delete image

image_id.description: Unique identifier of the cat image to retrieve.

images.get.title: Get image

images.list.description: List images uploaded to The Cat API account via /images/upload.

limit.description: Number of images to return (1-10, default 10).

sub_id.description: Filter images uploaded with this sub_id.

images.list.title: List uploaded images

images.search.description: Search approved cat images with optional size, type, breed, and paging filters.

format.description: Response format. json returns image objects; src returns the image bytes.

has_breeds.description: If true, only return images that have breed information attached.

mime_types.description: Comma-separated MIME types (e.g. jpg,png or gif).

images.search.title: Search images

jobs.get.description: Get one CATS job by ID.
jobs.get.title: Get job

jobs.list.description: List CATS jobs with optional page and per_page filters.
jobs.list.title: List jobs

votes.create.description: Vote on a cat image. Send image_id and value (1 upvote, 0 downvote). Optionally include sub_id.

image_id.description: The identifier of the cat image to vote on.

sub_id.description: Optional custom identifier to segment votes.

value.description: Vote value: 1 for upvote, 0 for downvote.

votes.delete.description: Delete a vote from The Cat API account by its ID.

vote_id.description: The unique identifier of the vote to delete.

vote_id.description: The unique identifier of the vote to retrieve.
